name: Tír inna mBéo
text: Tír inna mBéo is a variant form of the name Tir na mBéo. The dictionary prints the head as a one-line cross-reference. The record of the Land of the Living sits under the Tir na mBéo node. Both forms name the same deathless land. Voyage tales use either spelling.
